summary: Checked 119 programs, 62 of them open to apply right now. 51 could not be confirmed and are worth a manual look. 47 rows carried over from the previous run and were not rechecked.

programs.name: AI Cloud Credit for Research
programs.what_you_get: The program offers discounts on enterprise-grade AI infrastructure. The specific amount of credit is not published. You receive access to dedicated HGX H100 power and pre-configured GPU environments.
programs.who_qualifies: The page does not spell out specific eligibility criteria regarding funding stage or company age. Applicants must apply to check their eligibility for the program.

programs.name: AI Startup Program
programs.what_you_get: Startups receive up to $25,000 in credits for Dedicated Inference or Training and up to $2,500 in credits for Model APIs. Members also gain access to priority support, exclusive networking events, and go-to-market support including product launch amplification.
programs.who_qualifies: The program is for early-stage, AI-first startups that are VC-funded. Eligible companies must be at the Seed to Series A funding stage and have been started less than 5 years ago. Only net new customers who have never received Baseten credits before are eligible.

programs.name: AI21 benefits for NVIDIA Inception members
programs.what_you_get: Members receive 10% off private AI deployments. Additionally, members get $1,000 in AI21 Studio credits to experiment with language models and test applications.
programs.who_qualifies: The program is available to members of the NVIDIA Inception program. The page does not spell out further eligibility requirements.
programs.notes: The offer is specifically for NVIDIA Inception members.

programs.name: Akash Console Quick Start free trial
programs.what_you_get: The program offers $100 in free credits in ACT. These credits are valid for 30 days. Trial deployments are limited to a 24-hour maximum duration per deployment.
programs.who_qualifies: The page does not spell out specific eligibility requirements for the trial. It is available to users who sign up via the Akash Console.
programs.notes: Trial deployments have a 24-hour maximum duration per deployment, but you can redeploy as many times as you want within your 30-day trial period.

programs.name: Alibaba Cloud AI Catalyst Program
programs.what_you_get: The program offers up to 2 billion free Model Studio tokens and up to $120,000 in cloud credits. Participants receive POC coupons and 1:1 office hours with AI experts. Additionally, members get 12 months of access to Alibaba Cloud Academy and invitations to global events.
programs.who_qualifies: The program is interested in startups working on AI video or image creation, AI model aggregation, and content moderation. Applicants must submit an online form for review. Successful applicants are notified via email within 4-5 business days.

programs.name: Anyscale
programs.what_you_get: The page mentions a $100 credit for getting started. Users can also access dozens of code templates on the Anyscale Platform.
programs.who_qualifies: The page does not spell it out.

programs.name: Arm Flexible Access for Startups
programs.what_you_get: Early stage silicon startups may be eligible for the same benefits of the Arm Flexible Access program at zero cost. This includes access to a wide range of Arm IP, tools, and training. License fees are only due at the point of manufacture.
programs.who_qualifies: Early stage silicon startups may be eligible. The page does not spell out specific funding stages or age requirements. Interested parties must contact an Arm representative to inquire.
programs.notes: The program is specifically for silicon startups. Fees for IP are only due at tape out.

programs.name: AssemblyAI Startup Program
programs.what_you_get: Accepted startups receive 12 months of recurring free credits to use on core voice AI infrastructure, including Speech-to-text, Streaming speech-to-text, and Dictation APIs. The program also provides discounted startup pricing that continues after credits expire, hands-on guidance from Forward Deployed Engineers, and exclusive co-marketing opportunities. The specific dollar amount of the credits is not published.
programs.who_qualifies: The program is open to early-stage startups ranging from bootstrapped teams to Series A funding. Applicants must be building a product with speech at its core and planning to launch within six months. Portfolio companies of partner VCs like Accel and Y Combinator receive fast-tracked application reviews.
programs.notes: Discounted pricing does not apply to the LLM Gateway.

programs.name: AWS Activate
programs.what_you_get: Startups can receive up to $200,000 in AWS Activate Credits to offset costs on infrastructure, data services, and AI/ML models. These credits are redeemable on third-party models on Amazon Bedrock. AI startups ready to grow may be eligible for additional credits beyond the standard Activate offer.
programs.who_qualifies: The program supports startups at any stage of growth or level of funding, from ideating an MVP to those on track for an IPO. The page does not spell out specific eligibility requirements regarding company age or referral needs.

programs.name: AWS Activate
programs.what_you_get: The program offers AWS credits ranging from $1,000 to $100,000+ depending on the specific partner channel and startup stage. These credits cover core AWS services like EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, and DynamoDB for a period of 12 months. Northflank itself is a platform that allows you to use these credits by deploying to your own AWS account.
programs.who_qualifies: Eligibility varies by program tier. The AWS Activate Founders tier is for bootstrapped startups with fewer than 10 employees and under $1M in revenue. Other routes require affiliation with specific partners like YC Startup School, Stripe Atlas, or recognized VC and accelerator programs.
programs.notes: Credits do not cover AWS Marketplace purchases, premium support plans, or third-party SaaS products. Credits are typically one-time per company and cannot be transferred between accounts.

programs.name: Beam
programs.what_you_get: The program offers $30 in free credit refreshed monthly. This credit can be used to run sandboxes and GPU workloads on their cloud.
programs.who_qualifies: The page does not spell out specific eligibility requirements for the credit program. It is available to users who start building on the platform.

programs.name: Cerebras Inference Cloud
programs.what_you_get: The program offers a free trial on the Cerebras Inference Cloud. The specific amount of credits or duration of the trial is not published.
programs.who_qualifies: The page does not spell out eligibility requirements for the free trial. It is available to developers looking to build AI-powered applications.

programs.name: Claude for Startups
programs.what_you_get: The program offers Claude API credits and priority rate limits. The specific dollar amount of credits is not published. Participants also gain access to community events, resources, and program perks.
programs.who_qualifies: The program is open to early-stage founders and startups. To qualify for credits, companies must have received equity funding from an institutional investor, been founded within the last four years, and not previously received Anthropic startup credits.
programs.notes: Credits are only valid for the first-party Claude API via the Claude Console and cannot be used on AWS Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI, or other third-party platforms.

programs.name: ClickHouse Startup Offer
programs.what_you_get: Startups receive $5000 in ClickHouse Cloud credits valid for 12 months. The offer also includes basic support, opportunities to be featured in a joint blog post, and speaking opportunities at community events.
programs.who_qualifies: Eligible startups must be less than three years old and pre-Series D. Applicants must be part of a selected partner program, have a valid verification code from their accelerator, incubator, or VC, and be new to ClickHouse Cloud.
programs.notes: Applicants must sign up for a ClickHouse Cloud trial and provide their Organization ID to apply.

programs.name: Cloudflare for Startups
programs.what_you_get: The program offers credits ranging from $10,000 to $350,000 for one year. Credits cover usage-based services like Workers, R2, and AI, while core security and networking features are included at no cost. Higher tiers provide additional benefits such as account managers, priority technical support, and office hours with experts.
programs.who_qualifies: Eligible startups must be incorporated within the last 10 years, funded up to Series B within the last 12 months, and actively developing a technology product. Applicants must have a valid website, a public social media presence, and a business email address. The program is for first-time applicants and excludes educational institutions, consultancies, and resellers.
programs.notes: Credits are valid for one year and do not cover domain registration or AI Gateway services. Specific caps apply to R2 storage and Workers AI usage. Participants must have a valid payment method on file and will be billed for overages.

programs.name: Cloudflare for Startups
programs.what_you_get: The program offers credits ranging from $10,000 to $350,000 for one year, depending on the funding tier. Credits cover usage-based services like Workers, R2, and AI, while core security and networking features are included at no cost. Higher tiers provide additional benefits such as account management, priority technical support, and office hours with experts.
programs.who_qualifies: Startups must be incorporated within the last 10 years, be funded up to Series B, and have raised funds within the last 12 months. Applicants must be building a technology product, have a live website, and maintain a public social media presence. The program is for first-time applicants only and requires a business email address.
programs.notes: Credits are valid for one year and do not cover registrar services or AI Gateway. Specific caps apply to R2 storage and Workers AI usage. Participants must have a valid payment method on file and will be billed for overages.

programs.name: Confluent Cloud
programs.what_you_get: Users receive $400 in credits to start building. This allows access to the data streaming platform to launch clusters and connect data sources.
programs.who_qualifies: The page does not spell out specific eligibility requirements for startups. It mentions that organizations of all sizes, from startups to global enterprises, use the platform.

programs.name: CoreWeave Accelerator Program
programs.what_you_get: Accepted startups receive CoreWeave Cloud credits and additional discounts on compute resources. The program also provides access to support engineers and introductions to venture-capital firms. The specific dollar amount of credits is not published.
programs.who_qualifies: The program is open to innovative, cutting-edge, AI- and machine-learning-focused companies. It also considers any company requiring compute-intensive workloads in industries such as visual effects, animation, and synthetic biology. There are no application deadlines.

programs.name: Crusoe Intelligence Foundry
programs.what_you_get: Users receive $5 in free credits to fine-tune and serve models. The platform provides serverless fine-tuning and inference deployment capabilities.
programs.who_qualifies: The page does not spell it out.

programs.name: Databricks Startup Program
programs.what_you_get: Self-funded startups receive up to $1,000 in Neon credits, while VC-backed startups receive up to $200,000 in Neon and Databricks credits. Both tiers include onboarding support and early access to new features. VC-backed startups also receive co-marketing and speaking opportunities. Credits are valid for 12 months from the date of acceptance.
programs.who_qualifies: Self-funded startups must have less than $1M in funding and be building an early-stage product or MVP. VC-backed startups must have raised at least $1M or be participating in a recognized accelerator like Y Combinator. The program is open to both new and existing users.
programs.notes: Applications are reviewed by the team and typically receive a response within a few business days.

programs.name: Databricks Startup Program
programs.what_you_get: Qualifying startups can receive up to $200,000 in credits across Databricks and Neon. The program also provides hands-on technical guidance and go-to-market support. Founders gain access to partner and community networks.
programs.who_qualifies: The program is designed for early-stage, venture-backed startups. It is specifically for companies that have raised institutional funding from pre-seed through Series A. Applicants should be building their company on data and AI.

programs.name: Deepgram for Startups
programs.what_you_get: Participants receive up to $100,000 in API credits to use for STT, TTS, and Voice Agent capabilities. These credits are valid for 12 months. Additionally, startups gain access to invite-only events, engineering support groups, and the Deepgram startup community.
programs.who_qualifies: Applicants must be an AI builder or an early-stage startup. The company must be in production or planning to launch within the next 6 months. Participants must also be committed to actively building and engaging with the Deepgram community.
programs.notes: Credits are deposited within 24-48 hours of acceptance. Applicants must create a Deepgram account and provide a Project ID to apply.

programs.name: DeepStart
programs.what_you_get: The program offers 1,000,000,000 free tokens. This amount is based on DeepSeek V3.1 prices.
programs.who_qualifies: Startups must have raised between 250K and 10M USD. The company must have been founded in the last 2 years.

programs.name: Denvr AI Ascend
programs.what_you_get: The program offers an initial $1,000 start-up credit. Eligible teams can receive up to $500,000 in production credits for Denvr AI Cloud services.
programs.who_qualifies: The program is designed for early-stage AI developers and adopters. Eligibility is based on needs and potential.

programs.name: DigitalOcean Startups
programs.what_you_get: The program provides DigitalOcean credits to help startups deploy and scale infrastructure over 12 months. Participants receive 15 months of free Standard-tier paid support and access to the DigitalOcean startup community. Select startups may be invited to apply for separate GPU credit packages. The specific amount of credits varies by participant.
programs.who_qualifies: The program prioritizes AI-native startups that have raised $10 million or less. Applicants must have a company website and a business email address associated with their company domain. Service-based startups such as marketing agencies or consulting firms are not eligible. Applicants must create a new DigitalOcean team account with a valid credit card.
programs.notes: Core credits exclude GPU Droplets, NVIDIA H100 GPU, Kubernetes Bare Metal GPUs, Dedicated Inference, Serverless Inference, third-party AI models, Paperspace Machines, and Cloudways services. Participants are subject to a $10,000 monthly credit limit. Credits are not transferable and cannot be used for cryptocurrency mining.

programs.name: E2E Networks Startup Program
programs.what_you_get: The program offers three tiers: AI Explorer with $5K in credits, AI Builder with up to $50K in discounts, and AI Scaler with up to $100K in discounts. Participants also receive hands-on engineering support and access to NVIDIA H200/H100 capacity. The program claims to provide 60% cost savings.
programs.who_qualifies: Eligibility varies by tier. AI Explorer is for bootstrapped or early-stage companies with 10 or fewer employees founded within five years. AI Builder requires $2M+ raised and an AI-first product beyond the prototype stage. AI Scaler requires $5M+ raised and substantial compute demand for companies founded within seven years.
programs.notes: Credits for the AI Explorer tier are free-to-use, while the AI Builder and AI Scaler tiers provide usage-based discounts.

programs.name: ElevenLabs Grants
programs.what_you_get: The program provides 33,000,000 characters, which is over 680 hours of Agents usage, valued at over $4,000. Participants receive 12 months of free access to the full ElevenLabs platform. Additionally, members gain access to exclusive in-person and online founder events and startup support.
programs.who_qualifies: The program is open to startups and companies with fewer than 25 employees. Applicants must have a business or monetization strategy and intend to build a long-term product. Agencies, consulting firms, and existing enterprise customers are not eligible. Projects targeting minors are also excluded.
programs.notes: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and decisions are typically made within one week. If the 33 million character limit is reached before the 12-month term ends, the plan automatically converts to a Free plan.

programs.name: fal for Startups & Builders
programs.what_you_get: The Builder Grant offers $25 to $250 in credits for indie builders. The Startup Program offers $1,000 to $5,000 in credits for scaling startups, plus partner perks and priority intros. Credits grow based on monthly usage thresholds on the fal platform.
programs.who_qualifies: Both programs are open to teams based in Europe and Asia. The Builder Grant is for bootstrapped or indie developers building a direct generative media app. The Startup Program is for companies with proven traction or venture backing that are scaling their usage.
programs.notes: Credits are for building your own product and cannot be resold or transferred. Only one program per company is allowed, and applications are limited to once every three months.

programs.name: Fireworks for Startups
programs.what_you_get: Eligible startups receive credits that expire after 1 year to help with prototyping and scaling. The program also provides access to applied AI experts, an exclusive startup community, collaborative roadmap sessions, and joint marketing opportunities. The specific dollar amount of the credits is not published.
programs.who_qualifies: Startups must be a registered, privately held, for-profit entity with a functional website. They must have been founded within the last 5 years and be venture-backed with more than $500,000 in funding. Companies must not have received Series D or later funding.
programs.notes: Credits apply only to on-demand usage and do not cover reserved GPU capacity, professional services, or premium support.

programs.name: Huawei Cloud Startup Program
programs.what_you_get: The program provides cloud-native infrastructure and professional services. Startups can receive up to $150,000 in credit vouchers for cloud adoption. It also includes talent development and business resources.
programs.who_qualifies: The program is aimed at Nigerian startups. Huawei Cloud is committed to empowering 100 Nigerian startups over the next two years. The page does not spell out specific funding stage or company age requirements.

programs.name: IBM Sofia Accelerator
programs.what_you_get: The program provides access to IBM Cloud credits and IBM watsonx technology. Participants also receive mentorship, coaching, industry knowledge, and access to investors and clients. The amount of credits is not published.
programs.who_qualifies: The program targets companies that have already received funding in the post-Seed and Round A stages. It focuses on startups working in digital health, customer experience, sustainability, cybersecurity, fintech, AI, data, and quantum computing. Up to ten startups are accepted per class.
programs.notes: This is a 12-week intensive professional program that includes a Demo Day at the conclusion.

programs.name: JioBusiness Startups Solutions
programs.what_you_get: The program offers various support services including access to JioCloud, mentorship, hiring support, and go-to-market assistance. Startups can benefit from freemium and OPEX charge models, with claims of up to 90% cost savings from Jio and partners. Specific credit amounts are not published.
programs.who_qualifies: Eligibility is divided into three stages: 'Just started out' for ideation to early traction, 'Building' for early traction to growth phase, and 'Grow' for growth or mature phase. Companies must be self, seed, or Series A+ funded depending on their stage. The program is open to startups from inception up to 3+ years.
programs.notes: The program acts as an aggregator for various partner offers, including Microsoft Azure, GitHub, and LinkedIn, rather than being a single compute credit program. Not rechecked on this run.

programs.name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
programs.what_you_get: The program offers up to USD$150,000 in Azure credits. It also provides access to AI models, developer tools, and expert technical guidance. Additionally, startups gain access to Microsoft's global customer network to assist with go-to-market success.
programs.who_qualifies: The page does not spell out specific eligibility criteria regarding funding stage or company age. It mentions that applicants can sign up if they have an investor referral code or want to start building with Azure.

programs.name: Migration credits
programs.what_you_get: The program offers up to $10,000 in migration credits. The page does not specify additional support or benefits.
programs.who_qualifies: The page does not spell out eligibility requirements for the migration credits. It only mentions that the offer is for those migrating production infrastructure.

programs.name: Modal for Startups
programs.what_you_get: The program offers thousands of free GPU credits. Participants also receive technical support from Modal's engineering team and GTM amplification. Additionally, members gain access to an exclusive community of founders.
programs.who_qualifies: The program is for new Modal customers. Eligibility is based on funding stages, including seed to Series A startups that have raised VC funding from a partner network or over $1 million from any fund. Scaling and Series B+ companies must have raised over $30 million or be post-series B with a VC partner.
programs.notes: Credits are a one-time grant and cannot be reapplied for once received in a given tier.

programs.name: MongoDB for Startups
programs.what_you_get: The program provides Atlas credits, Voyage AI tokens, technical expertise, and dedicated support. The specific dollar amount of credits is not published. Startups receive access to one-on-one sessions with experts and go-to-market opportunities.
programs.who_qualifies: Startups must be less than 7 years old and at Series A funding or earlier. They must be building a scalable software-based product or service. Development shops and agencies are not eligible. Applicants must have an active company website and LinkedIn profile.
programs.notes: Credits are valid for 12 months after activation. Promo codes apply only to future charges, not past usage. Extensions for credit expiration are considered on a case-by-case basis.

programs.name: Novita AI for Startups
programs.what_you_get: Eligible startups can receive up to $10,000 in usage credits for Model APIs and Agent Sandbox. The program provides $1,000 upfront, followed by a 1:1 match for the next $5,000, and a 1:2 match for the final $4,000. Participants also receive dedicated support from Novita engineers and marketing promotion across Novita channels.
programs.who_qualifies: Startups must be venture-backed and at Series B stage or earlier. They must be building an AI-native product or platform and be new Novita users. Approval is based on team, funding, traction, and expected usage.
programs.notes: Credits are split into $5,000 for Agent Sandbox and $5,000 for Model API usage. Credits are valid for one year.

programs.name: NVIDIA Inception
programs.what_you_get: Members receive access to developer tools, training, and preferred pricing on select NVIDIA hardware and software. The program also provides access to free cloud credits from partners and exposure to a network of investors. The specific amount of credits is not published.
programs.who_qualifies: Startups must be officially incorporated, less than 10 years old, and employ at least one developer. They must also maintain a working website. Consulting firms, cryptocurrency companies, cloud service providers, resellers, and public companies are not eligible.
programs.notes: Preferred pricing is provided as a rebate through suppliers rather than direct sales. The program has no equity requirements or application fees.

programs.name: NVIDIA Inception and NVIDIA Connect cloud credit offer
programs.what_you_get: Companies receive an exclusive $7,500 cloud credit offer. These credits can be applied toward on-demand NVIDIA GPU instances and serverless API endpoints for inferencing open-source models.
programs.who_qualifies: The offer is available to companies participating in the NVIDIA Inception and NVIDIA Connect programs. Interested parties must access the offer through the NVIDIA portal for these members.
programs.notes: The program includes no rate limits on the inference endpoint, no quota for on-demand GPU access, and no egress or ingress fees.

programs.name: NVIDIA Inception Program
programs.what_you_get: Members receive up to $100,000 in AWS credits and up to $100,000 in NVIDIA DGX Cloud credits for H100 capacity. The program also provides preferred GPU pricing, free technical training, and co-marketing support. There are no equity requirements or fees for participation.
programs.who_qualifies: Startups must be officially incorporated, maintain a working website, and be less than 10 years old. The company must use at least one developer and be actively developing an AI product. Consulting firms, resellers, and crypto-focused startups are excluded.
programs.notes: The 30% DGX Cloud discount requires a minimum commitment of 4 nodes and $75,000 in spend. AWS credit amounts vary based on eligibility and startup profile.

programs.name: OpenRouter for Startups
programs.what_you_get: Eligible startups receive up to $3,000 in universal inference credits usable across over 500 models. Additionally, participants get 0% processing fees for 12 months. These credits are non-transferable and cannot be exchanged for cash.
programs.who_qualifies: The program is open to pre-Series B startups building AI-native products full-time. Applicants must have a public company website, a professional email matching their company domain, and less than $500 in lifetime OpenRouter spend. A referral from an approved OpenRouter partner is required.
programs.notes: Credits typically expire 6 months after issuance. Applicants must not have previously received startup credits.

programs.name: OVHcloud Startup Program
programs.what_you_get: The Start level provides 10,000 Euro in cloud credits and 6 hours of 1-on-1 engineering time. The Scale level offers up to 100,000 Euro in cloud credits and up to 20 hours of 1-on-1 engineering time. Both levels include visibility for the company and access to market and funding opportunities.
programs.who_qualifies: The program is open to startups and scaleups. The page does not specify funding stage, company age, or regional requirements.
programs.notes: The credits are valid for 12 months.

programs.name: Pinecone for Startups
programs.what_you_get: Participants receive free access to the Standard Tier and Pro Support. This includes access to any cloud or region deployment, RBAC, backups, import, and Prometheus metrics. Startups also receive usage credits and discounts, though the specific amounts are not published.
programs.who_qualifies: Eligible startups must have fewer than 100 employees. The company must be at the Series A funding stage or earlier.

programs.name: Qdrant for Startups
programs.what_you_get: Participants receive a 20% discount on Qdrant Cloud for the first year. The program also provides access to expert technical advice sessions. Additionally, members receive exclusive perks from partners including Hugging Face, LlamaIndex, and Airbyte.
programs.who_qualifies: Eligible startups must be at the Pre-seed, Seed, or Series A stage and under five years old with less than $5M in funding. Applicants must be building an AI-driven product and be new users of Qdrant Cloud or have created their account within the last 30 days. Agencies and devshops are not eligible for the program.
programs.notes: The discount is valid for 12 months and requires billing directly through Qdrant via Stripe. Participants must add credit card details to their account to utilize the discount.

programs.name: Redis Startup Program
programs.what_you_get: The program offers free Redis for 6 months, subject to usage limits. Participants receive early access to new features and products. Additionally, the program provides dedicated customer support, including monthly office hours and a basic support plan, as well as co-marketing and networking opportunities.
programs.who_qualifies: The page does not spell out specific eligibility criteria such as funding stage or company age. It mentions the program is for growing businesses. Applicants must apply through the provided form to be considered.
programs.notes: The free offer is limited to 6 months and subject to usage limits.

programs.name: Runpod Startup Program
programs.what_you_get: The Growth Tier offers $25,000 in bonus credits when you commit $50,000 upfront, totaling $75,000 in credits. The Starter Tier provides $1,000 in free credits for platform use. Both tiers include full access to Pods, Serverless, Clusters, and Storage.
programs.who_qualifies: The program is selective and primarily for venture-backed startups from Seed to Series B+ stage. Applicants should have production workloads, active investors, and a clear path to scale. Existing customers may be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.
programs.notes: The Growth Tier requires a 12-month agreement and an upfront financial commitment.

programs.name: Runware Grant Program
programs.what_you_get: The program offers up to $30,000 in API credits valid for 12 months. Participants also receive direct access to the Runware team and builder community channels. The credits can be used for image, video, audio, and language model generation on the production platform.
programs.who_qualifies: Applicants must be early-stage startups before Series A with a real product or credible MVP. Teams must be building or launching on Runware within the next six months. Bootstrapped teams are welcome, and no venture funding or investor introductions are required.
programs.notes: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis with a response time of two weeks.

programs.name: SambaNova Startup Accelerator
programs.what_you_get: Participants receive free enterprise-tier usage limits on SambaNova Cloud during part of the program. The program also provides priority support from AI experts, early access to new features, and opportunities for marketing exposure. Additionally, startups gain access to advanced computing infrastructure and strategic networking opportunities.
programs.who_qualifies: The program is designed for early-stage AI startups, specifically those at the Series A or B funding stage. Applicants should have a strong vision for agentic AI applications and a desire to collaborate on future developer features. The selection committee reviews applications and contacts shortlisted candidates.

programs.name: Shambho and Rudra AI Startup Accelerators
programs.what_you_get: The programs provide access to Yotta's sovereign GPU cloud infrastructure for AI model development and large-scale model training. Participants receive mentorship from domain experts, technical development support, architecture optimization, and go-to-market assistance. The amount of credits or specific compute hours is not published.
programs.who_qualifies: Shambho is designed for early-stage deep-tech entrepreneurs and startups in AI research, ML tools, and data analytics. Rudra is focused on growth-stage startups that have validated prototypes and are looking to scale solutions for enterprise and government sectors. The page does not spell out specific age or funding requirements.

programs.name: SingleStore Helios
programs.what_you_get: The program offers $500 in credits for new users. This credit can be used to start building with the SingleStore Helios platform.
programs.who_qualifies: The page does not spell out specific eligibility requirements such as funding stage or company age. It is presented as a general offer for those who start using the service.

programs.name: Snowflake for Startups
programs.what_you_get: The program offers free usage on a startup's first contract to help build their business on Snowflake. Participants also gain access to technical expertise, go-to-market guidance, and a global network of investors, partners, and customers. The specific amount of free usage is not published.
programs.who_qualifies: The program is for startups working with data, particularly those building products where data is a core component. It is also suited for companies leveraging AI and machine learning or dealing with large and complex datasets. The page does not spell out specific funding stages or age requirements.

programs.name: Startup India
programs.what_you_get: The program provides access to tax benefits, easier compliance, and IPR fast-tracking for recognised startups. It also offers financial assistance through the Seed Fund Scheme for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry, and commercialisation. The specific amount of financial assistance is not published.
programs.who_qualifies: Eligible companies must meet specific criteria set by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) to receive recognition. The page does not spell out the exact age or funding stage requirements for these benefits.

programs.name: Startup Program
programs.what_you_get: The program offers free credit, mentorship, and access to cloud native experts. The specific amount of credit is not published for the startup program, though new accounts generally receive $250 in free credit for one month.
programs.who_qualifies: The page does not spell out specific eligibility requirements such as funding stage or company age. It mentions being trusted by ambitious startups.

programs.name: Startup Program
programs.what_you_get: The program offers up to €3,000 in free cloud credits to help startups build and scale their MVP. Participants also receive 24/7/365 expert human support.
programs.who_qualifies: The page does not spell out specific eligibility criteria such as funding stage or company age. Interested parties are invited to apply through the website.

programs.name: Startup Program
